On-chain investigator ZachXBT issued an alert on his channel stating that fintech giant Revolut appears to have mistaken a fraudulent government information request for a legitimate one, consequently disclosing user data to unauthorized parties. Huobi Founder Leon Li Sells London Mansion for £190M After Buying It for £139M

According to the Financial Times, Huobi founder Leon Li recently sold The Holme, a mansion in London's Regent's Park, for approximately £190 million. Li purchased the property for £139 million in 2024, resulting in a price difference of roughly £51 million in less than two years. Li's ownership had not previously been made public because the property was held through a UK subsidiary of trust services provider Zedra. The buyer was Abbas Sajwani, son of Dubai property developer Hussain Sajwani. — link

Robinhood CEO: Tokenized Stocks Do Not Need Company Approval if Underlying Share Rights Remain Unchanged

Robinhood Co-founder and CEO Vlad Tenev said that public companies should control the rights attached to their shares, but not every lawful use investors make of those shares after acquiring them. Issuer consent should be required if a tokenized product alters the rights of the underlying shares, replaces the company’s official shareholder register, or imposes new obligations on the company or its transfer agent. Bitcoin ETFs See $13.29M Net Outflows on September 11 (ET), Extending Outflow Streak to Four Days; Ethereum ETFs See $216M Net Inflows

According to SoSoValue data, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded total net outflows of $13.29 million on September 11 (ET), marking the fourth consecutive day of net outflows. Morgan Stanley’s MSBT posted the largest single-day net inflow among spot Bitcoin ETFs, at $3.76 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded total net inflows of $216 million, with BlackRock’s ETHA leading at $149 million. — link

According to The Wall Street Journal, that investors have all but concluded that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week for the first time in three years, with attention now shifting to the policy path that follows. Since almost no one at the central bank believes a single 25-basis-point increase would do much on its own to curb inflation, a rate hike next week could indicate that officials view the current level of interest rates as too low and may take further action. BitMEX Co-Founder Ben Delo Donates Record £36 Million to Reform UK

BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo has donated £36 million to Reform UK, marking the largest single donation ever received by a British political party. Delo said he had originally planned to donate £1 million per month from now until the Labour government holds a general election, which must take place by 2029. However, concerned that the government could introduce limits on large political donations, he decided to transfer the entire amount at once. Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia to bring the chipmaker in as an anchor investor for its planned IPO, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Anthropic is seeking to raise as much as $100 billion at a valuation of around $2 trillion, while Nvidia is considering investing up to $10 billion in the offering. Binance Research: Tokenized Stocks Shift From Issuance to Distribution and Usage

Binance Research said the tokenized stock market is shifting from an issuance race to a competition over distribution and usage. Active tokenized stock market capitalization has risen 314% YTD to $4 billion, while monthly trading volume increased from $237 million in January to $7.9 billion in August and turnover rose from 0.23x to 2.14x. bStocks and Robinhood’s combined share of tracked issuer volume jumped from 0.8% in June to 82.3% in August and 87.8% so far in September.

Grayscale: Zcash Mining Rewards Are About 2x Bitcoin’s per Machine and 4x per MWh

Grayscale said strong Zcash price performance has made ZEC mining highly profitable, encouraging more mining activity and strengthening network security. It estimates that a Zcash mining rig currently generates roughly twice the daily mining rewards of a Bitcoin miner and about four times as much revenue per megawatt-hour, although the hardware used to mine the two assets is not interchangeable. CoinShares: Latest CPI Print Not Particularly Helpful for Bitcoin

CoinShares said the latest CPI print was not particularly helpful for Bitcoin. Headline inflation was broadly in line with expectations, while core inflation came in slightly above forecasts, raising the probability of a September rate hike and the risk that monetary policy remains restrictive for longer. With no dovish catalyst from CPI, Bitcoin’s near-term upside is likely to remain constrained, and a move above $80,000 may require weaker economic data, a more dovish Fed, or another policy catalyst. — link

Latin America’s Largest Digital Bank Nu Launches in U.S. and Unveils USDC/EURC Global Account

Nu has launched operations in the U.S. while separately introducing Nu Global, a multi-currency digital account for cross-border users. Its U.S. offering includes deposit accounts, credit cards and international transfers through partner bank Lead Bank, while Nu Global converts deposits into USDC or EURC and supports transfers across more than 35 countries. Nu said it serves more than 140 million customers globally. — link
